name: Kadmiel
overview: Kadmiel is identified in Scripture as a Levite closely associated with Jeshua and the children of Hodaviah, playing a significant role among the Levites during the post-exilic period. He and his descendants are noted for their involvement in leading worship and supporting the rebuilding of the house of God, as seen in their active participation alongside Jeshua in organizing the workmen and leading devotions. The Levites, including Kadmiel, are depicted as faithful servants who cried out to the LORD with a loud voice, demonstrating their dedication to God's service and the spiritual restoration of Israel.
